# Canada.ca

> The official Government of Canada portal for federal services, benefits, departments, public information, and online transactions.

Canada.ca is the central access point for Government of Canada programs, services, forms, guidance, and institutional information. It organizes federal content by topics, departments, and audiences, and provides bilingual access in English and French.

## Main Portal and Navigation
- [Canada.ca home](https://www.canada.ca/en.html): Main entry point to Government of Canada services, information, and departments.
- [Government of Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/system.html): Overview of how the federal government is organized and operates.
- [Departments and agencies](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/dept.html): Directory of federal departments, agencies, and organizations.
- [Public service and military](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/publicservice.html): Information about the public service, military, and federal workforce.
- [Open government](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/system/open-government.html): Access open data, open information, and transparency initiatives.
- [News](https://www.canada.ca/en/news.html): Government news releases, media advisories, and official announcements.
- [Prime Minister](https://www.canada.ca/en/prime-minister.html): Information about the Prime Minister, priorities, and statements.

## Services and Benefits
- [Benefits](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits.html): Federal benefits for individuals, families, seniors, and workers.
- [Public pensions](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/publicpensions.html): Canada Pension Plan, Old Age Security, and related retirement benefits.
- [Employment Insurance benefits and leave](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/ei.html): EI benefits, eligibility, leave, and application guidance.
- [Taxes](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/taxes.html): Personal, business, and sales tax information and online services.
- [Immigration and citizenship](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/immigration-citizenship.html): Immigration, visas, citizenship, and permanent residence services.
- [Travel and tourism](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/travel.html): Travel documents, advisories, border information, and tourism resources.
- [Health](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/health.html): Public health guidance, health services, and safety information.
- [Money and finances](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/finance.html): Banking, debt, financial consumer information, and economic topics.

## Jobs, Work, and Business
- [Jobs](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/jobs.html): Employment, training, workplace standards, and job search resources.
- [Find a job](https://www.jobbank.gc.ca/home): Job Bank listings, career tools, and labour market information.
- [Workplace standards](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/jobs/workplace.html): Federal labour standards, pay, leave, and workplace rights.
- [Business and industry](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/business.html): Starting, operating, and growing a business in Canada.
- [Business taxes](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/taxes/businesses.html): Corporate tax, payroll, GST/HST, and business tax obligations.
- [Grants and funding](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/business/grants.html): Federal funding, grants, loans, and support programs for businesses.
- [Science and innovation](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/science.html): Research, innovation, intellectual property, and science policy resources.

## Immigration, Passports, and Travel
- [Immigration and citizenship](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/immigration-citizenship.html): Entry point for immigration, citizenship, and newcomer services.
- [IRCC](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship.html): Departmental portal for Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada.
- [Passports](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/canadian-passports.html): Apply for, renew, or replace a Canadian passport.
- [Visit Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/visit-canada.html): Visitor visas, eTA, and travel requirements for visitors.
- [Permanent residence](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/immigration-citizenship/permanent-residence.html): Permanent residence pathways, eligibility, and application information.
- [Citizenship](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/immigration-citizenship/citizenship.html): Apply for citizenship, proof of citizenship, and test preparation.
- [Travel advice and advisories](https://travel.gc.ca/travelling/advisories): Official destination-specific travel advisories and safety information.

## Taxes and Money
- [Taxes](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/taxes.html): Central hub for tax filing, payments, credits, and accounts.
- [Canada Revenue Agency](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency.html): CRA programs, services, and tax administration information.
- [Income tax](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/taxes/income-tax.html): Personal and business income tax guidance and filing resources.
- [Tax credits and benefits for individuals](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/child-family-benefits.html): CRA-administered benefits, credits, and family payments.
- [My Account for individuals](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/e-services/e-services-individuals/account-individuals.html): Secure online access to personal tax and benefit information.
- [GST/HST](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/taxes/gsthst.html): Goods and services tax and harmonized sales tax guidance.
- [Money and finances](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/finance.html): Financial literacy, debt, mortgages, and consumer protection topics.

## Health, Safety, and Emergencies
- [Health](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/health.html): Health services, disease prevention, and public health information.
- [Public Health Agency of Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/public-health.html): Public health programs, surveillance, and guidance.
- [Food and nutrition](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/health/food-nutrition.html): Food safety, nutrition guidance, and healthy eating resources.
- [Drugs and health products](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/health/drug-health-products.html): Regulation and safety information for drugs and medical products.
- [Product safety](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/health/product-safety.html): Consumer product recalls, alerts, and safety guidance.
- [Emergency management](https://www.canada.ca/en/public-safety-canada/services/emergency-management.html): Federal emergency preparedness and disaster management information.
- [Weather information](https://weather.gc.ca/): Official weather forecasts, warnings, and climate conditions.

## Government, Law, and Justice
- [Government of Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/system.html): Structure, institutions, and responsibilities of the federal government.
- [How government works](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/system/how-government-works.html): Explanations of Parliament, Cabinet, and federal decision-making.
- [Treaties, laws and regulations](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/system/laws.html): Access laws, regulations, and legal resources.
- [Justice laws website](https://laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/): Consolidated federal acts and regulations in force.
- [Policing, justice and emergencies](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/policing.html): Justice system, policing, corrections, and emergency topics.
- [Access to information and privacy](https://www.canada.ca/en/treasury-board-secretariat/services/access-information-privacy.html): Federal ATIP policies, requests, and privacy guidance.
- [Elections and democracy](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/culture/democracy.html): Democratic institutions, participation, and civic information.

## Departments and Institutional Sites
- [Employment and Social Development Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development.html): Departmental portal for jobs, benefits, pensions, and social programs.
- [Service Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/corporate/portfolio/service-canada.html): Service delivery organization for benefits, pensions, and identification services.
- [Canada Revenue Agency](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency.html): Tax administration and benefit delivery organization.
- [Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship.html): Immigration, citizenship, passports, and newcomer services.
- [Health Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada.html): Federal health policy, regulation, and health protection department.
- [Public Services and Procurement Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/public-services-procurement.html): Procurement, pay, pensions, and government services administration.
- [Global Affairs Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/global-affairs.html): Foreign affairs, international trade, and development assistance.
- [National Defence](https://www.canada.ca/en/department-national-defence.html): Defence policy, military operations, and Canadian Armed Forces information.

## Online Accounts and Transactions
- [Sign in to an account](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/sign-in-online-account.html): Directory of Government of Canada online accounts and sign-in options.
- [CRA My Account](https://www.canada.ca/en/revenue-agency/services/e-services/e-services-individuals/account-individuals.html): Secure individual tax account access and services.
- [My Service Canada Account](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html): Access EI, CPP, OAS, and other Service Canada services.
- [GCKey](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/sign-in-online-account/gckey.html): Government credential service for secure online sign-in.
- [IRCC secure account](https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/application/account.html): Manage immigration and citizenship applications online.
- [ArriveCAN](https://www.canada.ca/en/border-services-agency/services/arrivecan.html): Official information about the ArriveCAN travel and border app.
- [Change your address](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/change-address.html): Update address information for participating federal programs.

## Data, Transparency, and Publications
- [Open government](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/system/open-government.html): Federal open data, information, and transparency resources.
- [Open data portal](https://open.canada.ca/en/open-data): Search and download Government of Canada open datasets.
- [Open information portal](https://open.canada.ca/en/open-information): Access government publications, reports, and disclosure records.
- [Search government publications](https://publications.gc.ca/site/eng/home.html): Find official federal publications and documents.
- [Proactive disclosure](https://open.canada.ca/en/proactive-disclosure): Browse mandated disclosures on spending, contracts, and travel.
- [Consulting with Canadians](https://www.canada.ca/en/government/system/consultations/consultingcanadians.html): Public consultations and opportunities to provide feedback.
- [Statistics Canada](https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/start): Official statistics, census data, and analytical reports.

## News, Media, and Contact
- [News](https://www.canada.ca/en/news.html): Government-wide news releases, statements, and media products.
- [Media advisories](https://www.canada.ca/en/news/advanced-news-search/news-results.html?start=1&end=&idx=0&dprtmnt=&typ=mediaadvisories): Search official media advisories across departments.
- [Backgrounders](https://www.canada.ca/en/news/advanced-news-search/news-results.html?start=1&end=&idx=0&dprtmnt=&typ=backgrounders): Search government backgrounders and supporting materials.
- [Contact the Government of Canada](https://www.canada.ca/en/contact.html): Central contact directory for departments, services, and support.
- [Service Canada contact centre](https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/corporate/contact.html): Contact information for Service Canada programs and services.
- [Social media](https://www.canada.ca/en/social.html): Official Government of Canada social media channels.
- [Mobile applications](https://www.canada.ca/en/mobile.html): Directory of official Government of Canada mobile apps.
